name: Cassette Game Finder
tagline: Find browser games to play on Cassette
description: Search browser games, read game details, find similar games, and list genres. This read-only server needs no account or API key. Connect over Streamable HTTP at https://cassette.gg/mcp. Documentation: https://cassette.gg/agents/find-a-game.md. The server is vendor-hosted; its implementation is not public source.
